crossRefs.note: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

translations.web: Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.
translations.bsb: Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
translations.kjv: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.
translations.asv: Our soul hath waited for Jehovah: He is our help and our shield.
